title: ID0406250-DC/Si-D/PL-[MP / R8 170002531] -Modbus documentation
description:
Reported behavior/ issue:
In the MODBUS Sicharge D documentation, the item is indicated: Actual Average EVSE Active Power (G_APower_Actual) 17 uint 100 kW Where does the station get this information from? From the PLC or the AC input meter? In addition, there is probably an error in the MODBUS documentation. The values for addresses 41 and 46 are given in A, while those for 43 and 48 are given in kW. Aren't these addresses interchanged with each other? And please interpret which addresses get the information from where, whether from the AC meter or from the PLC, etc.?
Root cause:
Solution:
DAMEX : no
Warranty : yes
